purpose: Prevent visually attractive but field-inaccurate assets. Current Korean construction-site reality is the primary geometry and assembly reference.

source_priority.source: user-provided current-site photos and direct field observations
source_priority.rule: Treat as ground truth for visible geometry, component combinations, spacing relationships, attachment methods, work-platform arrangement and actual site wear.

source_priority.source: current Korean safety guidance / manufacturer manuals / certified product documentation
source_priority.rule: Use to verify component names, intended function, load path and required connection/stability logic when the photo alone is ambiguous.
Use only for texture/lighting/composition. Never override current-site geometry.

pre_generation_gate: Identify the exact item currently used on site.
Confirm visible component names and their roles.
Confirm how components are physically connected or seated.
Record any site-specific geometry that differs from generic textbook illustrations.
post_generation_gate: Compare generated geometry side-by-side with the current-site reference.
Reject if a critical member is omitted, added arbitrarily, floating, mis-seated or structurally implausible.
Reject if it looks like generic scaffolding when the reference shows system shoring.
Reject if material thickness, connection hardware or support relationship is visibly unrealistic.
Only approved assets proceed to binary registration and catalog final.

observed_configuration: galvanized steel standards and ledgers in a dense grid
adjustable jack bases at slab level with base plates/support pads
U-head screw jacks at the top of standards
steel bearer/mong-e members physically seated in the U-heads
upper horizontal connecting/stabilizing members visible around the U-head/bearer zone
perforated steel work-platform/deck panels used through the shoring grid
diagonal bracing present in applicable bays
real site context includes wall/column formwork and active RC construction
must_preserve: jack base -> standard -> U-head -> bearer/mong-e -> slab formwork load path
ledger grid connected at the standard nodes
actual upper-level stabilization relationship visible in the supplied photos
realistic spacing/proportions instead of generic scaffold spacing
physically seated U-head and bearer with no floating or impossible contact
reject: bearer floating above or beside U-head
generic scaffold substituted for system shoring
missing ledgers or invented diagonal members inconsistent with reference
cartoon/pictogram simplification that hides connection logic

evidence_rule.technical_function_claims: Cross-check with Korean safety guidance or manufacturer documentation when needed.
evidence_rule.uncertainty: If a component function cannot be confirmed from the reference, mark it unresolved and do not invent it.
